work.title: Let's build something.
work.prose1: I'm Sagdi — I started in design, learned to ship full-stack, and moved into product. I like small teams, honest software, and problems where taste and engineering both matter.
work.prose2: Right now I'm looking for a product role where I can build, not just manage. If that's the kind of person you're after, I'd like to talk.
